textRuns.value: The work order's honest bottom line: on researched typical figures a pool MISSES the 5.00% hurdle on lesson revenue alone (-10.44%/yr before membership uplift). Breakeven needs ~42,011/yr of new membership or rental revenue; clearing the hurdle needs ~62,136/yr. The decisive missing number is JSV's own dues & demand data (RESEARCH REQUIRED) - and the board's mission score, which this model deliberately never invents.
